en.primary_text: You know your run before the sun comes up. That is what a dedicated account gives you — the same lanes, the same rhythm, every week. This seat pays $90,000 per year and comes with health insurance. Apply today.
en.headline: Dedicated. Health insurance.

es.primary_text: Conoces tu ruta antes de que salga el sol. Eso es lo que da una cuenta dedicada: las mismas rutas, el mismo ritmo, cada semana. El puesto paga $90,000 per year e incluye seguro médico. Únete hoy.
es.headline: Dedicado. Seguro médico.

en.primary_text: Dedicated means you are not guessing where you go next. The sun rises and you already know the road ahead. This CDL-A position pays $90,000 per year. Health insurance is included. Join our team.
en.headline: Dedicated CDL-A driver needed.

es.primary_text: Dedicado significa que no adivinas a dónde vas. Sale el sol y ya conoces el camino. Esta posición CDL-A paga $90,000 per year. Seguro médico incluido. Aplica y únete al equipo.
es.headline: Chofer CDL-A, cuenta dedicada.

en.primary_text: Before dawn you are already in the seat, and this job makes sure you are taken care of. Health insurance and $90,000 per year on a dedicated account — consistent work, consistent pay. Apply today.
en.headline: Health insurance. Dedicated run.

es.primary_text: Antes del amanecer ya estás al volante, y este trabajo se asegura de cuidarte. Seguro médico y $90,000 per year en una cuenta dedicada: trabajo constante, pago constante. Aplica hoy.
es.headline: Seguro médico. Ruta dedicada.
